# blamethe.tech

An opinion site by Fred Nix (@nixfred) about why Windows is a worse daily driver than Omarchy, with macOS as a decent but expensive middle. Funny-savage tone. Every charge against Windows (and every ding at Mac) is backed by a source URL, preferably Microsoft's or Apple's own documentation, or a reputable outlet quoting it.

Site: https://blamethe.tech/
Author: Fred Nix, https://x.com/nixfred
Not affiliated with Microsoft, Apple, or Basecamp.

Omarchy is an Arch Linux + Hyprland desktop by DHH and the Omarchy project. Fred uses it. He did not build or maintain it.
Omarchy: https://omarchy.org/
Fred's Omarchy hub: https://omarchy.nixfred.com/

## The charges (with sources)

1. Start menu ads / recommendations
   https://www.theverge.com/2024/4/24/24138949/microsoft-windows-11-start-menu-ads-recommendations-setting-disable
   https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/privacy/privacy-settings-for-recommendations-offers-in-windows-11

2. Microsoft account required during Windows 11 Home / Pro personal setup
   https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/windows-11-specifications
   https://blogs.windows.com/windows-insider/2025/10/06/announcing-windows-11-insider-preview-build-26220-6772-dev-channel/

3. Recall takes periodic snapshots of the screen (later made opt-in and local)
   https://blogs.windows.com/windowsexperience/2024/06/07/update-on-the-recall-preview-feature-for-copilot-pcs/
   https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/privacy/privacy-and-control-over-your-recall-experience

4. Automatic updates and restart to finish them
   https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/deployment/updates-lifecycle/keep-your-pc-up-to-date-with-active-hours

5. Required diagnostic data cannot be set to off on Home or Pro
   https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/privacy/diagnostics-feedback-and-privacy-in-windows
   https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/client-management/mdm/policy-csp-System

6. Preinstalled apps and promotional Start tiles
   https://www.howtogeek.com/windows-11-promises-to-clean-up-bloat-but-disabling-its-own-features-is-the-only-thing-that-works/

7. TPM 2.0 and compatible-CPU requirements; Canalys estimate of about 240 million PCs that could not officially upgrade
   https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/windows-11-specifications
   https://www.tomshardware.com/software/windows/microsofts-draconian-windows-11-restrictions-will-send-an-estimated-240-million-pcs-to-the-landfill-when-windows-10-hits-end-of-life-in-2025

8. Windows 10 support ended October 14, 2025
   https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/deployment/updates-lifecycle/windows-10-support-has-ended-on-october-14-2025

Omarchy themes (Super + Ctrl + T, 22 themes): https://omarchy.org/manual/themes/

Static HTML, CSS, and JS only. No accounts, no API, no analytics.
